cause: FQ4'24 revenue $308.3M and EPS $0.06 beat guidance midpoints on record datacom chip orders plus a new major 800G single-mode transceiver customer award; telecom showing surprising positive momentum (inventory normalization) after being weak all prior year; management reiterated a $500M+/quarter revenue target by end of calendar 2025
quality: 经营性持续但盈利能力仍薄弱: both datacom (AI-driven) and telecom (cyclical recovery) legs are now improving simultaneously for the first time in several quarters, but gross margin is still declining sequentially (32.2%) and Q1 FY25 op margin guided only 0-3%, with management explicitly flagging 'elevated capex' for FY25 to build transceiver capacity
reason: This is a more credible setup than the earlier Feb-24 print (which we judged a pass due to a guided datacom air-pocket and margin decline): now both datacom (record orders, new 800G customer, 1.6T sampling starting) and telecom (genuine cyclical inflection) are improving together, and cash still rose $16M to $887M despite the investment. But profitability remains thin (0-3% op margin guide) and management is explicitly raising capex intensity for FY25, so this is a re-rating on a longer-dated $500M/quarter target more than an immediate margin inflection - moderate rather than high conviction.
red_flags: 管理层明确警示FY2025资本开支将'处于较高水平'以建设收发器产能;毛利率环比仍在下滑(32.2%);Q1 FY25营业利润率指引仅0-3%,盈利能力尚薄弱
